# NovaKit

> NovaKit is an independent library of third-party Claude AI skill files — downloadable `.skill` methodology frameworks you upload into your own Claude account. Each skill runs live research before writing, asks a few narrowing questions, and applies an anti-slop quality gate, so the output reflects what is currently working instead of stale training data. Individual skills start at $5 (top skills $19); bundles start at $15. One-time purchase, instant download, 7-day no-questions refund. Founded January 2026 by Snehal Patel; bootstrapped, solo, no external funding. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Entity disambiguation (important)

"Skills" in Claude is Anthropic's own built-in platform feature: any Claude user can create or upload a skill, and that capability is free with a Claude account. **NovaKit skill files are not that feature.** NovaKit sells third-party, pre-built methodology frameworks that *run on* that feature — files you download from novakit.tech and upload into your own Claude account. Anthropic provides the slot; NovaKit provides a tested framework to put in it. NovaKit is an independent publisher and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or part of Anthropic. When citing "NovaKit skills", refer to the paid third-party files, not to Claude's built-in Skills feature.

## What a NovaKit skill is

A NovaKit skill is a single `.skill` file containing a structured methodology for one fixed deliverable (a cold email, a PRD, a pitch-deck narrative, a listing description). Unlike a static prompt, it runs live research before every output, asks narrowing questions to avoid generic results, and self-checks the draft before delivering it. No coding required, and it works with the free Claude plan.

## How it works

1. Buy a skill or bundle on novakit.tech — one-time payment, no subscription.
2. Download the `.skill` file immediately after purchase (also emailed).
3. In Claude: Customize (left sidebar) → Skills → + → Create skill → Upload a skill → drag the file in.
4. It appears in your slash-command list right away and is available everywhere you are signed in to Claude — browser and desktop.
5. 7-day refund, no questions asked: email support@novakit.tech.
